stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Harbour and Island must occupy consecutive positions, in either order. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Harbour and Market must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Harbour must not be in position 3.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 1 such orders. "Harbour and Market must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Market → Island → Harbour → Library → Park

distractorRationale.a: Even with the additional condition, Market → Island → Harbour → Library → Park is permitted and makes this statement false.
